description: This header file defines the exported APIs for the COSA (Cisco Open Service Architecture) Library plugin, including functions for initialization, support checks, and unload operations, with licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COSA plugin with a maximum supported version and plugin info handle.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjSupported
methods.description: Checks if the specified object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin.
